modernization.rideSource: Recorded drive totals; missing measurements remain unknown.
modernization.gSource: Latest reported acceleration; missing axes are not zero.
modernization.loadedSpeeds: Average and maximum of the loaded trips, including any current drive; not a complete-range aggregate.
modernization.motorSource: Latest reported motor signals; not selected-trip history.

review.subtitle: Understand one ride: energy outcome, powertrain evidence, and the signals behind it.
review.evidenceDescription: Power delivery, recovered power, axle load, and temperature — sampled only within the selected trip window.
review.liveDescription: Latest reported motor, pedal, G-force, gear, and cruise state for this vehicle. These readings may be parked or older than now and do not describe the selected ride.
review.contextDescription: Vehicle coaching covers the last 30 days. Speed and power analytics cover loaded trips in the selected date range, plus any current drive. Neither is a score for this ride.
review.speedGearScope: Gear and motor power: latest vehicle signals. Average and top speed: loaded trips in the date range, not just the selected ride.

trip.title: Trip review
trip.reviewDescription: Choose a ride to review its recorded outcome and motor samples. Current vehicle signals and multi-trip context are separated below.

ride.title: Selected ride
ride.energyMeaning: Energy recovered is recorded regeneration, not peak regen power. Missing measurements remain unknown; these totals do not rate driving style.
ride.empty: Choose a trip with recorded data to review its outcome.

powertrain.title: Powertrain summary
powertrain.coverage: Up to {{limit}} motor samples inside the selected drive. Averages describe reported samples, not a time-weighted or complete-trip assessment.
powertrain.empty: No motor samples in this drive window. Trip totals remain available above; current readings are kept separate below.
powertrain.outputEvidence: Peak sampled power {{power}}; peak sampled regen {{regen}}. These are instantaneous readings, not trip energy totals.
powertrain.loadEvidence: Peak reported axle torque {{torque}}; hottest recorded motor {{temperature}}. A missing axle or temperature signal limits the evidence.
powertrain.inputsEvidence: Motor power does not establish pedal position or braking technique. Pedal, G-force, gear, and cruise panels below show current vehicle signals, not this trip’s historical inputs.

evidence.torqueMeaning: Sum of reported axle torque. Sample share is not time spent under load or a driver rating.
evidence.powerMeaning: Measured motor output, not pedal position. Power alone cannot classify driving style.
evidence.thermalMeaning: Average of the hotter reported motor in each sample. Temperature alone does not establish thermal limiting or powertrain health.

guidance.title: How to read this ride
guidance.empty: No measured motor evidence available for trip-specific guidance.
guidance.power: Compare power peaks with the trip’s speed and road conditions. Average motor power alone cannot tell whether acceleration was smooth or efficient.
guidance.regen: Review energy recovered alongside energy used. A peak regen reading is not a measure of braking quality, and friction-brake use cannot be reconstructed from motor power.
guidance.torque: Use the front and rear torque traces to see which axle reported load. Gaps are missing telemetry, not evidence that an axle was inactive.
guidance.thermal: Temperature adds context to sustained motor load. Without the vehicle’s limiting signals, these samples do not prove overheating or reduced power.

liveInterpretation.title: Live powertrain interpretation
liveInterpretation.empty: No current axle torque, regen, or acceleration signals reported.
liveInterpretation.limits: Observed values only — not a launch, grip, thermal-health, or selected-trip assessment.
liveInterpretation.thermal: Hottest reported stator/inverter {{temp}}. Thermal limiting has not been established.
liveInterpretation.parked: The latest reported shift state is Park; this is current vehicle context.
liveInterpretation.load: Axle torque is a reported motor measurement, not a driver rating or a claim about vehicle motion.
liveInterpretation.regen: Regeneration is reported in current motor signals. Peak power does not establish recovered trip energy.
liveInterpretation.brakeOff: The brake switch reports inactive alongside regeneration signals.
liveInterpretation.brakeOn: The brake switch reports active alongside regeneration signals. Friction-brake force is not measured here.
liveInterpretation.pedal: Pedal and axle torque signals are present. They do not establish launch performance.
liveInterpretation.axleShare: Rear axle accounts for {{share}}% of reported absolute axle torque. This does not establish traction or grip.

contextCharts.loadDescription: Recorded average motor power versus trip distance — not peak power or acceleration
contextCharts.loadAria: Per-drive scatter chart of average motor power versus trip distance
contextCharts.profileDescription: Average power (left, kW) and recovered energy (right, kWh) for the latest 20 loaded trips
contextCharts.profileAria: Recent-drives average motor power and recorded recovered energy on separate axes

dynamics.powerProfileDesc: Peak & regen power for recent drives

coach.scopeDescription: Completed drives with positive recorded energy and available speed, power, and temperature over the last 30 days. Scores compare consumption with this vehicle’s best measured trip; power and speed profiles are heuristics, not observed braking technique or safety ratings.
coach.title: Driving coach
coach.noData: Drive more to see your style breakdown.
coach.needWeeks: Need at least 2 weeks of data for trend analysis.
coach.noRecs: Recommendations will appear after more drives.
coach.weeklyTrendAria: Line chart of weekly driving score over time

dynamics.tipNoData: Drive your vehicle to start collecting dynamics data.
dynamics.tipEaseAccel: Ease into the accelerator — gradual inputs save energy and tire wear.
dynamics.tipBrakeEarly: Brake earlier and lighter to improve regen capture.
dynamics.tipSmoothThrottle: Smooth throttle transitions can improve efficiency by 10–15%.
dynamics.tipCoast: Lift off the pedal earlier to let regen do the work.
dynamics.tipGreat: Excellent driving style! Maintaining this maximizes range and comfort.
dynamics.tipKeep: Keep monitoring your scores — consistency is key.
dynamics.tipThermal: Motor temps are running high — consider easing off sustained high power.
dynamics.powerOverTimeDesc: Drive and regen power from motor telemetry
dynamics.torqueHistoryDesc: Front and rear motor torque over time
dynamics.rpmHistoryDesc: Front and rear motor RPM over time
dynamics.title: Driving dynamics
dynamics.subtitle: Live motor telemetry, G-forces & driving analysis

brief.cruiseScope: Current speed requires a trusted vehicle-state observation. Cruise set speed and follow distance are latest independent historical observations; their continuous freshness is not established.
brief.followScope: Reported follow-distance enum; its suffix is a bar setting, not a physical distance.

dynamics.autopilotNoData: No cruise / autopilot telemetry received yet

grok.honesty: Interpreted from live motor, pedal, and accelerometer signals. Not Autopilot, not the chassis controller, and not a 0–60 claim.
grok.rearShareUnknown: AWD split unknown — both axles have not reported torque yet.
grok.thermalUnknown: Motor thermal envelope not reported yet.

find.cornering: Lateral accelerometer {{g}} g. That is chassis load, not a grip percentage.
